title: Never-Ending Heavenly Powers
body:
Mankind is honoured by having the ability of being defenders of truth. That is the meaning of the word
Haqqani. If there were no defenders of truth, mankind would be finished, it is the only hope for mankind.
In the beginning people may use powers from nature. Then, when they find the way to higher stations, they
can use those. Whoever reaches Heavenly Powers, will have a supply of never-ending powers. But people
nowadays are concentrating more on the natural powers than on the Divine.
01.01.1996
